segments.title: The Seeker's Question
segments.muse_prompt: In the warm dawn golden light of Valmiki's forest hermitage, with thatched leaf huts beneath tall mango and ashoka groves and a thin trail of smoke rising from the morning sacred fire, the serene river gliding past a grassy bathing bank edged by flowering creepers, an elderly great sage with warm weathered wheat-brown skin and deep compassionate brown eyes stands barefoot in humble inquiry. His long white-grey matted hair gathered in a high topknot and flowing white beard frame white tripundra ash on his forehead, while his saffron-ochre cotton dhoti with rust-gold border and matching angavastram over his left shoulder carries a white sacred thread and rudraksha necklaces and bracelets, a wooden danda staff in his right hand and a wooden kamandalu with japa mala in his left. Before him stands an eternally radiant eternally youthful slender sage appearing twenty-five with warm fair luminous wheatish skin and large joyful dark-brown eyes, his long black hair tied in a high rishi topknot and his face smooth and beardless, marked with a white U-shaped Vaishnav tilak with a central red sandal line. He wears a simple white cotton dhoti with thin saffron-gold woven border and a saffron angavastra over his left shoulder with triple rudraksha necklaces and white yajnopavita, holding an ancient mahati veena with twin golden-brown gourds near his shoulder and a polished brass kamandalu, listening with a delighted benevolent smile. The air glows with reverent curiosity as the elder leans forward in questioning and the sage inclines in warm attention, framed in a medium two-shot against the leaf-thatched huts and sacred fire beneath the forest canopy.

segments.title: Two Boons Exile
segments.muse_prompt: In the grand audience hall of Ayodhya with golden sandstone and white marble tiers, soaring shikharas, carved pillars, lotus-arch gateways and crimson-gold banners bathed in warm bright daylight, coronation vessels gleam beside a royal throne that waits empty. segments.title: Measure Before Hero
segments.muse_prompt: A young Indian woman storyteller in her late twenties with warm medium-brown skin and expressive dark eyes, her long jet-black hair in a neat side braid adorned with small white jasmine, wears a deep teal cotton saree with a thin gold border and simple gold jhumka earrings. segments.title: The Seeker's Question
segments.muse_prompt: In the warm dawn golden light of Valmiki's forest hermitage, with thatched leaf huts beneath tall mango and ashoka groves and a thin trail of smoke rising from the morning sacred fire, the serene river gliding past a grassy bathing bank edged by flowering creepers, an elderly great sage with warm weathered wheat-brown skin and deep compassionate brown eyes stands barefoot in humble inquiry. His long white-grey matted hair gathered in a high topknot and flowing white beard frame white tripundra ash on his forehead, while his saffron-ochre cotton dhoti with rust-gold border and matching angavastram over his left shoulder carries a white sacred thread and rudraksha necklaces and bracelets, a wooden danda staff in his right hand and a wooden kamandalu with japa mala in his left. Before him stands an eternally radiant eternally youthful slender sage appearing twenty-five with warm fair luminous wheatish skin and large joyful dark-brown eyes, his long black hair tied in a high rishi topknot and his face smooth and beardless, marked with a white U-shaped Vaishnav tilak with a central red sandal line. He wears a simple white cotton dhoti with thin saffron-gold woven border and a saffron angavastra over his left shoulder with triple rudraksha necklaces and white yajnopavita, holding an ancient mahati veena with twin golden-brown gourds near his shoulder and a polished brass kamandalu, listening with a delighted benevolent smile. The air glows with reverent curiosity as the elder leans forward in questioning and the sage inclines in warm attention, framed in a medium two-shot against the leaf-thatched huts and sacred fire beneath the forest canopy.

Prince Rama twenty-eight with azure-blue complexion and tall athletic broad-shouldered build and large lotus dark eyes, long jet-black hair in a matted ascetic jatabhara topknot, bare-headed and calm clean-shaven face with Vaishnava tilak, wearing golden-yellow silk dhoti with red and gold lotus border and sacred thread and layered pearls and golden armlets bracelets and emerald earrings and jeweled waistband with long Kodanda bow and back quiver, strides forward beside Princess Sita in her early twenties with warm golden-fair slender grace and large dark lotus eyes, long jet-black hair with red sindoor in thick waist braid entwined with white jasmine and gold pendant, draped in deep crimson silk saree with broad gold lotus and peacock border over emerald blouse with gold trim and adorned with maang-tikka and red bindi and gold nath and jhumkas and layered gold necklaces and red-gold bangles and kamarbandh and anklets, with Prince Lakshmana twenty-two, a youthful clean-shaven wheat-golden prince with lean athletic build and large dark brown lotus eyes and thick black hair in a high topknot bound with golden cord, wearing deep golden-yellow silk dhoti with red-gold bow-motif border and saffron angavastram and white sacred thread and round gold kundalas and thin armlets and wrist-guards and sandal-U tilak, walking tall in the foreground at Rama's side with tall curved bamboo longbow held in his hand and back quiver of eagle-feathered arrows and gold-hilted straight sword at his waist, in humble devoted attentiveness. The lone feathered Nishada King Guha about forty with deep warm dark-brown skin and sturdy broad-shouldered muscular build and large warm dark-brown kind loyal eyes under thick brows, thick black hair in high tribal topknot with red cord and peacock feather and short full beard and mustache and large circular brass earrings, wearing knee-length russet handwoven dhoti with mustard diamond border and green angavastram and layered rudraksha and wooden bead necklaces with brass armlets and cuffs, holding a stout bamboo longbow with cane quiver across back, bows in dignified humble greeting while the Ayodhyan royal charioteer in his late fifties with warm wheat-brown lean sturdy build and sorrowful dark eyes, short greying hair under saffron-yellow turban with small gold brooch and trimmed grey moustache and stubble, wearing cream dhoti with wide red and gold border and maroon angavastram with gold paisley and brown leather waistband and sandals with gold studs and rudraksha bracelet, waits back beside his turning chariot holding a short coiled brown leather whip. Behind them a trailing farewell crowd of Ayodhyans with folded palms lines the dusty trail, soft with distance and grief. Soft golden light bathes the riverbank in tender parting devotion.

Sweeping eye-level panorama binds ardent action on the beach with the churning patient sea, radiant with solemn power and joyful relief.

Lamps and marigolds deck the terrace as a soft rejoicing crowd fills the courts below, faces lost in petals and light.

segments.title: Measure Before Hero
segments.muse_prompt: A young Indian woman storyteller in her late twenties with warm medium-brown skin and expressive dark eyes, her long jet-black hair in a neat side braid adorned with small white jasmine, wears a deep teal cotton saree with a thin gold border and simple gold jhumka earrings. She sits cross-legged on a woven mat in a quiet lamp-lit study surrounded by stacked palm-leaf manuscripts and earthen diyas, unrolling a blank scroll while three polished brass weights gleam beside an ink pot. Her gaze lifts toward the soft lamplight with thoughtful purpose as she traces lines on the scroll, embodying the act of setting standards of gratitude, truth, and compassionate care. Warm amber light bathes her face and the textured manuscripts, creating a contemplative mood of preparation and clarity in a close intimate framing.

segments.title: The Seeker's Question
segments.muse_prompt: In the warm dawn golden light of Valmiki's forest hermitage, with thatched leaf huts beneath tall mango and ashoka groves and a thin trail of smoke rising from the morning sacred fire, the serene river gliding past a grassy bathing bank edged by flowering creepers, an elderly great sage with warm weathered wheat-brown skin and deep compassionate brown eyes stands barefoot in humble inquiry. His long white-grey matted hair gathered in a high topknot and flowing white beard frame white tripundra ash on his forehead, while his saffron-ochre cotton dhoti with rust-gold border and matching angavastram over his left shoulder carries a white sacred thread and rudraksha necklaces and bracelets, a wooden danda staff in his right hand and a wooden kamandalu with japa mala in his left. Before him stands an eternally radiant eternally youthful slender sage appearing twenty-five with warm fair luminous wheatish skin and large joyful dark-brown eyes, his long black hair tied in a high rishi topknot and his face smooth and beardless, marked with a white U-shaped Vaishnav tilak with a central red sandal line. He wears a simple white cotton dhoti with thin saffron-gold woven border and a saffron angavastra over his left shoulder with triple rudraksha necklaces and white yajnopavita, holding an ancient mahati veena with twin golden-brown gourds near his shoulder and a polished brass kamandalu, listening with a delighted benevolent smile. The air glows with reverent curiosity as the elder leans forward in questioning and the sage inclines in warm attention, framed in a medium two-shot against the leaf-thatched huts and sacred fire beneath the forest canopy.

Prince Rama twenty-eight with azure-blue complexion and tall athletic broad-shouldered build and large lotus dark eyes, long jet-black hair in a matted ascetic jatabhara topknot, bare-headed and calm clean-shaven face with Vaishnava tilak, wearing golden-yellow silk dhoti with red and gold lotus border and sacred thread and layered pearls and golden armlets bracelets and emerald earrings and jeweled waistband with long Kodanda bow and back quiver, strides forward beside Princess Sita in her early twenties with warm golden-fair slender grace and large dark lotus eyes, long jet-black hair with red sindoor in thick waist braid entwined with white jasmine and gold pendant, draped in deep crimson silk saree with broad gold lotus and peacock border over emerald blouse with gold trim and adorned with maang-tikka and red bindi and gold nath and jhumkas and layered gold necklaces and red-gold bangles and kamarbandh and anklets, with Prince Lakshmana twenty-two, a youthful clean-shaven wheat-golden prince with lean athletic build and large dark brown lotus eyes and thick black hair in a high topknot bound with golden cord, wearing deep golden-yellow silk dhoti with red-gold bow-motif border and saffron angavastram and white sacred thread and round gold kundalas and thin armlets and wrist-guards and sandal-U tilak, walking tall in the foreground at Rama's side with tall curved bamboo longbow held in his hand and back quiver of eagle-feathered arrows and gold-hilted straight sword at his waist, in humble devoted attentiveness. The lone feathered Nishada King Guha about forty with deep warm dark-brown skin and sturdy broad-shouldered muscular build and large warm dark-brown kind loyal eyes under thick brows, thick black hair in high tribal topknot with red cord and peacock feather and short full beard and mustache and large circular brass earrings, wearing knee-length russet handwoven dhoti with mustard diamond border and green angavastram and layered rudraksha and wooden bead necklaces with brass armlets and cuffs, holding a stout bamboo longbow with cane quiver across back, bows in dignified humble greeting while the Ayodhyan royal charioteer in his late fifties with warm wheat-brown lean sturdy build and sorrowful dark eyes, short greying hair under saffron-yellow turban with small gold brooch and trimmed grey moustache and stubble, wearing cream dhoti with wide red and gold border and maroon angavastram with gold paisley and brown leather waistband and sandals with gold studs and rudraksha bracelet, waits back beside his turning chariot holding a short coiled brown leather whip. Behind them a trailing farewell crowd of Ayodhyans with folded palms lines the dusty trail, soft with distance and grief. Soft golden light bathes the riverbank in tender parting devotion.

segments.title: Sandals of Trust

segments.title: Vow Against Rakshasas
segments.muse_prompt: In a vast primeval Dandaka wilderness of towering sal and teak and banyan and peepal with massive gnarled trunks and dense dark-green canopy laced with hanging aerial roots and vines, the forest floor of damp earth and fallen leaves and moss-covered rocks and ferns and wild jasmine opens into a serene clearing with small bamboo and straw thatched leaf huts and earthen fire altars bathed in golden-green daylight filtering in soft shafts through light morning mist. Prince Rama twenty-eight with azure-blue complexion and tall athletic broad-shouldered build and large lotus dark eyes, long jet-black hair in a matted ascetic jatabhara topknot, bare-headed and calm clean-shaven face with Vaishnava tilak, wearing golden-yellow silk dhoti with red and gold lotus border and sacred thread and layered pearls and golden armlets bracelets and emerald earrings and jeweled waistband with long Kodanda bow and back quiver, kneels with empty hands joined in humble anjali and head bowed to receive the blessing beside a glowing fire altar. Ancient short-statured sage Agastya with stocky pot-bellied build and warm dusky copper-brown skin and deep-set compassionate dark brown eyes beneath bushy grey brows, long grey-streaked black matted hair in high topknot with long grey beard and mustache and white tripundra sandal paste, wearing coarse saffron-ochre dhoti with woven gold-brown border and matching angavastram with deer-skin sacred thread and layered rudraksha necklaces bracelets, stands beside Rama with both hands empty and open in blessing above him, while the great jeweled bow lies unstrung on the ground at his feet with sword and quiver and abundant arrows resting beside it; no weapon is held, drawn, nocked, or pointed at anyone. Elder ascetics in rough barkcloth stand back from the fire in austere devotion, seen from behind with backs to the viewer and softly out of focus through drifting smoke, their bamboo staffs planted upright in the earth and earthen water pots resting at their feet as flames cast a warm glow across the clearing. Golden-green light shafts heighten the sacred and resolute mood of protection.

segments.title: Fourteen Thousand Fall
segments.muse_prompt: In a rugged Janasthana clearing of red-brown earth strewn with dark boulders among tall sal, teak and twisted banyan trees beneath Vindhya ridges and hazy amber late-afternoon light, azure-blue prince Rama with lotus-shaped dark eyes, jet-black hair in a matted ascetic jatabhara topknot, bare-headed, golden-yellow silk dhoti with red gold zari lotus motifs, pearl necklaces, golden armlets and sacred thread stands tall and calm with controlled Vaishnava tilak, loosing a single arrow from his drawn Kodanda bow with quiver on his back. Toward him through golden dust strides massive charcoal-grey Khara with fiery crimson eyes, tiger-skin sash and gold crest, mace raised high, leading dust-shrouded warriors carrying shields and banners, their faces lost in the dust, the front ranks already faltering and giving way as Rama holds his ground. Solitary heroic resolve meets the charge as the fourteen thousand press forward and break around him.

segments.title: Measure Before Hero
segments.muse_prompt: A young Indian woman storyteller in her late twenties with warm medium-brown skin and expressive dark eyes, her long jet-black hair in a neat side braid adorned with small white jasmine, wears a deep teal cotton saree with a thin gold border and simple gold jhumka earrings. Her gaze lifts toward the soft lamplight with thoughtful purpose as she traces lines on the scroll, embodying the act of setting standards of gratitude, truth, and compassionate care. Warm amber light bathes her face and the textured manuscripts, creating a contemplative mood of preparation and clarity in a close intimate framing.

Her open palm gestures toward the mural as daylight streams across scattered marigold petals, illustrated maps showing a hundred-yojana ocean leap toward an Ashoka grove, and clay cups of chai.
